record.bible_text: And the Spirit<WH07307> of God<WH0430> came upon Azariah<WH05838> the son<WH01121> of Oded<WH05752>:

And he gathered<WH06908><WTH8799> all Judah<WH03063> and Benjamin<WH01144>, and the strangers<WH01481><WTH8802> with them out of Ephraim<WH0669> and Manasseh<WH04519>, and out of Simeon<WH08095>: for they fell<WH05307><WTH8804> to him out of Israel<WH03478> in abundance<WH07230>, when they saw<WH07200><WTH8800> that the LORD<WH03068> his God<WH0430> <FI>was<Fi> with him.

And also <FI>concerning<Fi> Maachah<WH04601> the mother<WH0517> of Asa<WH0609> the king<WH04428>, he removed<WH05493><WTH8689> her from <FI>being<Fi> queen<WH01377>, because she had made<WH06213><WTH8804> an idol<WH04656> in a grove<WH0842>: and Asa<WH0609> cut down<WH03772><WTH8799> her idol<WH04656>, and stamped<WH01854><WTH8686> <FI>it<Fi> , and burnt<WH08313><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> at the brook<WH05158> Kidron<WH06939>. <RF>mother: that is, grandmother<Rf> <RF>idol: Heb. horror<Rf>

And there was no <FI>more<Fi> war<WH04421> unto the five<WH02568> and thirtieth<WH07970> year<WH08141> of the reign<WH04438> of Asa<WH0609>.<CM>
